instruction.text: Drag the flame to the building to find out more.

feedback.finish: The Great Fire of London started in the night of the 2nd of September 1666.

atoms.b: The Great Plague had only happened the year before in ((2005 ++1665)). This was a deadly disease that killed thousands of people.
The poor people of ((++London New_York)) who had survived the plague thought 1666 could only be better, but they had another hard year ahead!

instruction.text: Select all the tasks that fire was used for.

trainers.hint: More than one answer can be correct.

atoms.b: At the time, buildings were made out of ((chocolate ++wood)), and the roofs were made out of straw.
This meant that buildings caught ((++fire colds)) very easily!

instruction.text: Select the bakery sign to find out where the fire started.

end.text: The Great Fire of London started in a bakery on Pudding Lane. This bakery was owned by a man called Thomas Farriner.
end.sound: The Great Fire of London started in a bakery on Pudding Lane. This bakery was owned by A man called Thomas Farriner.

instruction.text: How do you think the Great Fire of London started?

feedback.end: Some people actually thought that the fire was started on purpose, so multiple people were questioned by the police, including Thomas Farriner.

b.sound: A spark from one of Thomas’s ovens started the fire
An egg from Thomas’s mixing bowl started the fire.
